in_arabic.name: عظیم
in_arabic.long_meaning: عظیم هو اسم عربي مشتق من الثلاثي عظم يَعظم، يعني العظيم الشأن والمقام، ذو القدر والمهابة، وهو اسم يُستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الله تعالى، كما يُستخدم كاسم علم للمواليد، وهو اسم يعكس القوة والسلطة والجلال

in_urdu.name: عظیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: عظیم ایک عربی نام ہے جو ثلاثی عظم سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی ہے بڑی شان والا، عظیم الشان، ذو قوت و مهابت، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اللہ تعالی کی توصیف کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، نیز یہ نام نیک بچوں کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو قوت، سلطنت، اور جلال کا phảnعک ہے

in_hindi.name: आज़ीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: आज़ीम एक अरबी नाम है जो त्रिलiteral आज़िम से व्युत्पन्न है, जिसका अर्थ है महान और शक्तिशाली, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में अल्लाह की व्याख्या के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, साथ ही यह नाम बच्चों के लिए भी उपयोग किया जाता है, जो शक्ति, शक्ति और महानता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: عظیم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عظیم د عربی نوم دی چې د ثلاثي عظم څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنی یې لوی او سترگ دی، دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې د الله تعالی د تشریح لپاره کارول کیږي، او دا نوم ماشومانو لپاره هم کارول کیږي، چې د قوت، ځواک او سترگی څرګندوي

in_english.name: Aazim
in_english.long_meaning: Aazim is an Arabic name derived from the triliteral root Azm, meaning great and powerful, this name is used in Islamic culture to describe Allah, as well as a given name for children, reflecting strength, power, and greatness, with roots in Quranic etymology and historical Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Aazim represents a sense of awe and reverence, reflecting the profound recognition of Allah's greatness and might in Islam. The name Aazim can be given to a boy as a reminder of the immense power and dignity bestowed upon every human being by Allah. In Islamic culture, this name carries a strong sense of respect, not only for Allah, but also for the inherent worth and potential of every individual.
data.spiritual_significance: Aazim carries a deep spiritual significance, emphasizing the belief in the expansive and all-encompassing power of Allah. It serves as a reminder of the immense potential within each believer to strive towards excellence and to act with greatness in accordance with Allah's divine will. The name Aazim inspires a sense of humility and submission to Allah's will, and encourages one to seek the strength and courage to face challenges with a strong and unwavering faith. It is a name that encourages the pursuit of a life that reflects the greatness and majesty of Allah, and a constant reminder of the importance of embodying virtuous character and unwavering faith. In essence, the name Aazim symbolizes the embodiment of Allah's greatness and power within each believer, and serves as a reminder to always strive towards excellence and righteousness in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Aazim ibn Qais Jahanaazib, a famous companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who fought in several battles including the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Hunain. He was known for his bravery and was given the title 'Aazim' which means 'great' or 'noble'.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history, period of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)

historical_references.reference: Aazim al-Qushairi, a prominent scholar in Islamic theology and jurisprudence from the 11th century. He founded the Qushairiyyah Sufi order and is known for his major work Al-Risala fi 'l-Tasawwuf, a treatise on Sufism and spiritual development.
historical_references.context: Medieval Islamic history, development of Sufism and Islamic scholarship
